title: Phone performance: background decoding and lighter menus
summary: Web Worker pool handles background asset decoding; loads yield every 8 ms for smooth animation and 2-5x performance gains
details: Web Worker pool decodes terrain textures, sky, sound banks, menu tune and course photos
Loads yield every 8 ms, keeping the loader animated and responsive
Terrain lookup index, UI atlas grows once, previews reused
'Still loading? Reload' option appears after 20 s
env01 load time: 19.5 s → 9.8 s (old JS game 10.9 s)
Longest frozen loader gap: 12.9 s → 1.3 s
Main menu engine time: 5.4 ms/frame → 2.1 ms/frame
limitation: Host Chromium at 4x CPU throttle (390x844 DPR 3), not physical phone; first-visit stall root cause unknown; second-load caching not implemented yet
caption: Responsive menu transitions during loading
